question_en: Which statements are true? 1) the period of a harmonic oscillator does not depend on the amplitude; 2) the period of a vertical spring pendulum depends on $g$; 3) for weak damping the energy decays $2$ times as fast as the amplitude; 4) steady driven oscillations occur at the natural frequency; 5) at resonance the velocity is in phase with the force.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) garmonik ossilyator davri amplitudaga bog'liq emas; 2) vertikal prujinali mayatnik davri $g$ ga bog'liq; 3) kuchsiz so'nishda energiya amplitudadan $2$ marta tez so'nadi; 4) barqaror majburiy tebranish xususiy chastotada bo'ladi; 5) rezonansda tezlik kuch bilan bir fazada.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) период гармонического осциллятора не зависит от амплитуды; 2) период вертикального пружинного маятника зависит от $g$; 3) при слабом затухании энергия затухает в $2$ раза быстрее амплитуды; 4) установившиеся вынужденные колебания идут на собственной частоте; 5) при резонансе скорость в фазе с силой.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Vertikal prujina davri faqat m/k ga bog'liq (2 xato); barqaror tebranish kuch chastotasida (4 xato).
Asos: majburiy tebranishlar.

uz: 1) chiziqli kuchda izoxronlik; 3) $E\propto A^2$, ya'ni $E\propto e^{-2\beta t}$; 5) $\omega=\omega_0$ da $\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}$, tezlik kuch bilan bir fazada: $$E=E_0e^{-2\beta t}$$
2) xato — $g$ faqat muvozanatni siljitadi; 4) xato — o'tkinchi qism so'ngach jism kuch chastotasida tebranadi: $$T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k}},\qquad x=A\cos(\omega t-\varphi)$$
ru: 1) изохронность при линейной силе; 3) $E\propto A^2$, т. е. $E\propto e^{-2\beta t}$; 5) при $\omega=\omega_0$ $\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}$, скорость в фазе с силой: $$E=E_0e^{-2\beta t}$$
2) неверно — $g$ лишь смещает равновесие; 4) неверно — после затухания переходной части тело колеблется на частоте силы: $$T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k}},\qquad x=A\cos(\omega t-\varphi)$$
en: 1) isochronism for a linear force; 3) $E\propto A^2$, i.e. $E\propto e^{-2\beta t}$; 5) at $\omega=\omega_0$ $\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}$, the velocity is in phase with the force: $$E=E_0e^{-2\beta t}$$
2) false — $g$ only shifts the equilibrium; 4) false — once the transient dies out the body oscillates at the driving frequency: $$T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k}},\qquad x=A\cos(\omega t-\varphi)$$

distractors.C: davr g ga bog'liq deb olingan; 3 tushib qolgan
distractors.D: barqaror tebranish xususiy chastotada deb olingan; 1 tushib qolgan
distractors.E: barqaror tebranish xususiy chastotada deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что период зависит от g; пропущено 3
distractors_ru.D: принято, что колебания идут на собственной частоте; пропущено 1
distractors_ru.E: принято, что колебания идут на собственной частоте

distractors_en.C: the period was taken to depend on g; 3 missed
distractors_en.D: steady oscillations were taken at the natural frequency; 1 missed
distractors_en.E: steady oscillations were taken at the natural frequency

source: original (B2-L07, tushuncha testi)

question_en: A load on a spring oscillates at frequency $\nu$. The spring is cut in half and the same load is hung on one half. What is the new frequency?
question_uz: Prujinadagi yuk $\nu$ chastota bilan tebranadi. Prujina teng ikkiga kesilib, xuddi shu yuk bitta yarmiga osildi. Yangi chastota qancha?
question_ru: Груз на пружине колеблется с частотой $\nu$. Пружину разрезали пополам и подвесили тот же груз на одну половину. Какова новая частота?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Yarim prujina bikrligi 2k (har bo'lak cho'zilishi yarmi), chastota √k ga proporsional: √2·ν.
Asos: prujinani bo'lish.

uz:
Bir xil kuchda yarim prujina ikki marta kam cho'ziladi — bikrligi $2k$; chastota bikrlik ildiziga proporsional: $$
u'=
u\sqrt{ rac{2k}{k}}=\sqrt{2}
u$$
ru:
При той же силе половина пружины растягивается вдвое меньше — жёсткость $2k$; частота пропорциональна корню из жёсткости: $$
u'=
u\sqrt{ rac{2k}{k}}=\sqrt{2}
u$$
en:
Under the same force half the spring stretches half as much — stiffness $2k$; the frequency is proportional to the square root of the stiffness: $$
u'=
u\sqrt{ rac{2k}{k}}=\sqrt{2}
u$$

distractors.A: bikrlik 2 marta kamaygan va chastota k ga proporsional deb olingan
distractors.B: yarim prujina bikrligi k/2 deb olingan
distractors.D: chastota k ga proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: принято, что жёсткость уменьшилась вдвое и частота пропорциональна k

distractors_en.A: the stiffness was taken to halve and the frequency to scale as k
distractors_en.B: half the spring was taken to have stiffness k/2
distractors_en.D: the frequency was taken proportional to k
distractors_en.E: the stiffness was taken as unchanged

source: Volkenshteyn, «Problems in General Physics», 12.25-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: On the Earth a simple pendulum has period $T_1$ and a load on a spring has period $T_2$. Both are taken to the Moon, where the free-fall acceleration is $6$ times smaller. What are the periods on the Moon?
question_uz: Yerda matematik mayatnik davri $T_1$, prujinadagi yuk davri $T_2$. Ikkalasi og'irlik tezlanishi Yernikidan $6$ marta kichik bo'lgan Oyga olib borildi. Oydagi davrlar qanday?
question_ru: На Земле период математического маятника $T_1$, период груза на пружине $T_2$. Оба перенесли на Луну, где ускорение свободного падения в $6$ раз меньше земного. Каковы периоды на Луне?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Mayatnik davri 1/√g ga proporsional — √6 marta ortadi; prujina davri faqat m/k ga bog'liq.
Asos: davr formulalari.

uz: Mayatnikda qaytaruvchi kuch og'irlikdan, prujinada — elastiklikdan: $$T_1'=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{6l}{g}}=\sqrt{6}T_1,\qquad T_2'=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k}}=T_2$$
ru: У маятника возвращающая сила — от тяжести, у пружины — упругая: $$T_1'=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{6l}{g}}=\sqrt{6}T_1,\qquad T_2'=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k}}=T_2$$
en: For the pendulum the restoring force comes from gravity, for the spring from elasticity: $$T_1'=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{6l}{g}}=\sqrt{6}T_1,\qquad T_2'=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k}}=T_2$$

distractors.B: prujina davri ham g ga bog'liq deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: принято, что период пружины тоже зависит от g

distractors_en.B: the spring's period was also taken to depend on g
distractors_en.C: the period was taken proportional to √g
distractors_en.D: the period was taken proportional to 1/g
distractors_en.E: the pendulum and the spring were swapped

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 15.61-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A thin uniform disc of radius $R$ hangs from a point on its rim on a horizontal axis perpendicular to the plane of the disc. What is the period of small oscillations?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan bir jinsli yupqa disk gardishidagi nuqtadan disk tekisligiga perpendikulyar gorizontal o'qqa osilgan. Kichik tebranishlar davri qancha?
question_ru: Однородный тонкий диск радиуса $R$ подвешен за точку обода на горизонтальной оси, перпендикулярной плоскости диска. Каков период малых колебаний?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. I = MR²/2 + MR² = 3MR²/2, a = R; keltirilgan uzunlik 3R/2.
Asos: fizik mayatnik, Shteyner teoremasi.

en: Parallel-axis theorem: $I=\frac{MR^2}{2}+MR^2=\frac{3}{2}MR^2$, $a=R$: $$T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{I}{MgR}}=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{3R}{2g}}$$

distractors.A: disk nuqtaviy massa deb olingan (I = MR²)

distractors_ru.A: диск принят за точечную массу (I = MR²)

distractors_en.A: the disc was treated as a point mass (I = MR²)
distractors_en.B: the hoop value I = 2MR² was used
distractors_en.C: I was taken about the center (no parallel-axis term)

source: original (B2-L07, fizik mayatnik)

question_en: A particle of mass $m$ makes small oscillations at the bottom of the potential well $U(x)=-U_0e^{-\frac{x^2}{a^2}}$. What is the angular frequency?
question_uz: Massasi $m$ bo'lgan zarra $U(x)=-U_0e^{-\frac{x^2}{a^2}}$ potensial o'ra tubida kichik tebranishlar qiladi. Siklik chastota qancha?
question_ru: Частица массой $m$ совершает малые колебания на дне потенциальной ямы $U(x)=-U_0e^{-\frac{x^2}{a^2}}$. Какова циклическая частота?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Teylor qatori: U ≈ −U₀ + U₀x²/a², ya'ni k = U″(0) = 2U₀/a².
Asos: kichik tebranishlar.

en: For small $x$, $e^{-u}\approx1-u$, so $U\approx-U_0+\frac{U_0}{a^2}x^2=-U_0+\frac{1}{2}kx^2$: $$k=U''(0)=\frac{2U_0}{a^2},\qquad \omega_0=\sqrt{\frac{2U_0}{ma^2}}$$

distractors_en.A: the factor ½ was forgotten (k = U₀/a²)
distractors_en.D: the second derivative was computed wrongly

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 4.16-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A harmonic oscillator has amplitude $A$. What fraction of the total energy is kinetic when the body passes $x=\frac{A}{2}$?
question_uz: Garmonik ossilyator amplitudasi $A$. Jism $x=\frac{A}{2}$ nuqtadan o'tayotganda uning to'liq energiyasining qancha qismi kinetik energiya?
question_ru: Амплитуда гармонического осциллятора $A$. Какая доля полной энергии приходится на кинетическую энергию, когда тело проходит точку $x=\frac{A}{2}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Potensial energiya x² ga proporsional: U/E = 1/4, demak Eₖ/E = 3/4.
Asos: tebranish energiyasi.

en: $U=\frac{kx^2}{2}$, $E=\frac{kA^2}{2}$: $$\frac{U}{E}=\frac{x^2}{A^2}=\frac{1}{4},\qquad \frac{E_k}{E}=\frac{3}{4}$$

distractors.E: energiya x ga chiziqli bog'liq deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: принято, что энергия линейна по x

distractors_en.D: the speed fraction v/v(max) was given
distractors_en.E: the energy was taken linear in x

source: Volkenshteyn, «Problems in General Physics», 12.19-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A particle in harmonic motion (amplitude $A$) is observed at a random time. What is the probability of finding it in the interval $-\frac{A}{2}<x<\frac{A}{2}$?
question_uz: Garmonik tebranayotgan zarra (amplitudasi $A$) tasodifiy vaqtda kuzatiladi. Uni $-\frac{A}{2}<x<\frac{A}{2}$ oraliqda topish ehtimoli qancha?
question_ru: Гармонически колеблющуюся частицу (амплитуда $A$) наблюдают в случайный момент. Какова вероятность найти её в интервале $-\frac{A}{2}<x<\frac{A}{2}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Ehtimollik vaqt ulushi: x = A sin θ, θ ∈ (−π/6, π/6) — yarim davrning uchdan biri.
Asos: ehtimollik zichligi.

en: Integrate the density (or use the phase fraction: $\frac{\pi/3}{\pi}$): $$P=\int_{-A/2}^{A/2}\frac{dx}{\pi\sqrt{A^2-x^2}}=\frac{2}{\pi}\arcsin\frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{3}$$

distractors.A: ehtimollik oraliq uzunligiga proporsional deb olingan
distractors.E: faqat bir tomondagi markaziy yarim olingan

distractors_ru.A: принято, что вероятность пропорциональна длине интервала
distractors_ru.E: взята центральная половина только с одной стороны

distractors_en.A: the probability was taken proportional to the interval length
distractors_en.D: the probability of the outer intervals was taken
distractors_en.E: only the central half on one side was taken

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 4.9-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The amplitude of a weakly damped oscillator decreased by a factor of $e$ in $30$ complete oscillations. What is the quality factor?
question_uz: Kuchsiz so'nuvchi ossilyator amplitudasi $30$ ta to'liq tebranishda $e$ marta kamaydi. Asllik qancha?
question_ru: Амплитуда слабо затухающего осциллятора уменьшилась в $e$ раз за $30$ полных колебаний. Какова добротность?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. λ = 1/30, Q ≈ π/λ = 30π ≈ 94.
Asos: asllik va logarifmik dekrement.

en: $N_e=30$ oscillations — logarithmic decrement $\lambda=\frac{1}{30}$: $$Q\approx\frac{\pi}{\lambda}=\pi N_e=30\pi\approx94$$

distractors.D: Q tebranishlar soniga teng deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: принято, что данные относятся к энергии
distractors_ru.E: вместо умножения на π выполнено деление

distractors_en.B: the data were taken to refer to energy
distractors_en.D: Q was taken equal to the number of oscillations
distractors_en.E: divided by π instead of multiplying

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 4.75-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A pendulum's amplitude decreases by $3$ percent each oscillation. By about what percent does its energy decrease each oscillation?
question_uz: Mayatnik amplitudasi har bir tebranishda $3$ foizga kamayadi. Har bir tebranishda uning energiyasi taxminan necha foizga kamayadi?
question_ru: Амплитуда маятника за каждое колебание уменьшается на $3$ процента. Примерно на сколько процентов уменьшается его энергия за каждое колебание?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. E ∝ A²: 0.97² ≈ 0.94, ya'ni taxminan 6 foiz.
Asos: tebranish energiyasi.

en: The energy is proportional to the square of the amplitude: $$\frac{E_2}{E_1}=0.97^2\approx0.941,\qquad 1-0.941\approx0.06$$

distractors_en.A: the energy was taken proportional to the amplitude
distractors_en.B: the energy was taken proportional to √A

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 15.51-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A body of mass $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ moves on a spring of stiffness $100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ in a viscous medium. For what drag coefficient $b$ is the damping critical?
question_uz: Massasi $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan jism bikrligi $100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ prujinada qovushoq muhitda harakatlanadi. Qarshilik koeffitsiyenti $b$ qancha bo'lganda so'nish kritik bo'ladi?
question_ru: Тело массой $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ движется на пружине жёсткостью $100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ в вязкой среде. При каком коэффициенте сопротивления $b$ затухание будет критическим?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. β = ω₀ sharti: b/(2m) = √(k/m), b = 2√(km) = 2·20 = 40 kg/s.
Asos: kritik so'nish.

en: Critical damping $\beta=\omega_0$, i.e. $\frac{b}{2m}=\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$: $$b=2\sqrt{km}=2\sqrt{400}=40\ \mathrm{kg/s}$$

distractors_en.D: the square root was not taken (b = km)

source: Volkenshteyn, «Problems in General Physics», 12.52-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: An oscillator has natural frequency $\omega_0=10\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$ and damping coefficient $\beta=6\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$. At what frequency is the amplitude of driven oscillations largest?
question_uz: Ossilyatorning xususiy chastotasi $\omega_0=10\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$, so'nish koeffitsiyenti $\beta=6\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$. Majburiy tebranishlar amplitudasi qaysi chastotada eng katta bo'ladi?
question_ru: Собственная частота осциллятора $\omega_0=10\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$, коэффициент затухания $\beta=6\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$. При какой частоте амплитуда вынужденных колебаний наибольшая?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. ω* = √(ω₀² − 2β²) = √28 ≈ 5.3 s⁻¹ — ω′ = 8 dan ham kichik.
Asos: amplituda rezonansi.

en: Amplitude resonance (it exists since $\beta<\frac{\omega_0}{\sqrt{2}}\approx7.07$): $$\omega^*=\sqrt{100-2\cdot36}=\sqrt{28}=2\sqrt{7}\approx5.3\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$$

distractors_ru.C: принято, что резонанс на собственной частоте

distractors_en.A: the damped frequency ω′ was taken
distractors_en.C: resonance was taken at the natural frequency

source: original (B2-L07, rezonans chastota)

question_en: A very weakly damped spring oscillator ($k$, $\omega_0$) is driven by $F_0\cos\omega t$ with $\omega=10\omega_0$. What are the steady-state amplitude and the phase lag of the displacement behind the force?
question_uz: Juda kuchsiz so'nuvchi prujinali ossilyatorga ($k$, $\omega_0$) $F_0\cos\omega t$ kuch ta'sir qiladi, $\omega=10\omega_0$. Barqaror tebranish amplitudasi va siljishning kuchdan orqada qolish fazasi qanday?
question_ru: На очень слабо затухающий пружинный осциллятор ($k$, $\omega_0$) действует сила $F_0\cos\omega t$, $\omega=10\omega_0$. Каковы амплитуда установившихся колебаний и отставание смещения от силы по фазе?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. β → 0: A = F₀/(m(ω² − ω₀²)) = F₀/(99k); ω > ω₀ da siljish kuchga qarama-qarshi.
Asos: majburiy tebranishlar.

en: For $\beta\to0$ the denominator is $m|\omega_0^2-\omega^2|=99m\omega_0^2=99k$; $\omega>\omega_0$ — antiphase: $$A=\frac{F_0}{99k},\qquad \varphi=\pi$$

distractors.A: ω > ω₀ da faza 0 deb olingan
distractors.B: amplituda ω ga teskari proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: принято, что при ω > ω₀ фаза равна 0
distractors_ru.B: принято, что амплитуда обратно пропорциональна ω

distractors_en.A: the phase for ω > ω₀ was taken as 0
distractors_en.B: the amplitude was taken inversely proportional to ω

source: original (B2-L07, chegaraviy hol)

question_en: The figure shows the average power delivered to an oscillator by the driving force as a function of the driving frequency. What is the quality factor of the oscillator?
question_uz: Rasmda ossilyatorga kuch beradigan o'rtacha quvvatning kuch chastotasiga bog'liqligi berilgan. Ossilyator aslligi qancha?
question_ru: На рисунке показана зависимость средней мощности, передаваемой осциллятору силой, от частоты силы. Какова добротность осциллятора?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Grafikdan ω₀ = 50 rad/s, yarim balandlikdagi kenglik Δω = 51 − 49 = 2 rad/s; Q = ω₀/Δω = 25.
Asos: rezonans egri chizig'i kengligi.

uz: Grafikdan: cho'qqi $\omega_0=50\ \mathrm{rad/s}$, quvvat yarmiga teng nuqtalar $49$ va $51\ \mathrm{rad/s}$: $$\Delta\omega=2\ \mathrm{rad/s},\qquad Q=\frac{\omega_0}{\Delta\omega}=25$$
ru: По графику: пик $\omega_0=50\ \mathrm{rad/s}$, точки половинной мощности $49$ и $51\ \mathrm{rad/s}$: $$\Delta\omega=2\ \mathrm{rad/s},\qquad Q=\frac{\omega_0}{\Delta\omega}=25$$
en: From the graph: peak $\omega_0=50\ \mathrm{rad/s}$, half-power points $49$ and $51\ \mathrm{rad/s}$: $$\Delta\omega=2\ \mathrm{rad/s},\qquad Q=\frac{\omega_0}{\Delta\omega}=25$$

distractors_en.B: β = 1 was used instead of the width (Q = ω₀/β)
distractors_en.C: the width was read as 4 rad/s
distractors_en.E: the width itself was given as the answer

source: original (B2-L07, P(ω) grafigi)

question_en: A weakly damped oscillator is driven by $F_0\cos\omega_0t$ at its natural frequency. By how much does the displacement lag behind the force in phase in the steady state?
question_uz: Kuchsiz so'nuvchi ossilyatorga uning xususiy chastotasiga teng chastotali $F_0\cos\omega_0t$ kuch ta'sir qiladi. Barqaror tebranishda siljish kuchdan fazada qanchaga orqada qoladi?
question_ru: На слабо затухающий осциллятор действует сила $F_0\cos\omega_0t$ с частотой, равной его собственной. На сколько по фазе смещение отстаёт от силы в установившемся режиме?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. ω = ω₀ da tg φ → ∞, φ = π/2: siljish π/2 ga orqada, tezlik esa kuch bilan bir fazada.
Asos: majburiy tebranish fazasi.

en: At $\omega=\omega_0$ the denominator is zero: $$\mathrm{tg}\,\varphi=\frac{2\beta\omega_0}{0}\to\infty\ \Rightarrow\ \varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}$$

distractors_en.E: the sign of the phase was reversed

source: original (B2-L07, rezonans fazasi)

question_en: In a series RLC circuit $R=10\ \Omega$, $L=40\ \mathrm{mH}$ and $C=0.1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Using the analogy with a mechanical oscillator, find the quality factor of the circuit.
question_uz: Ketma-ket RLC zanjirda $R=10\ \Omega$, $L=40\ \mathrm{mH}$, $C=0.1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Mexanik ossilyator bilan analogiyadan foydalanib, zanjir aslligini toping.
question_ru: В последовательной цепи RLC $R=10\ \Omega$, $L=40\ \mathrm{mH}$, $C=0.1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Используя аналогию с механическим осциллятором, найдите добротность цепи.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. m ↔ L, b ↔ R, k ↔ 1/C: Q = √(km)/b = √(L/C)/R = √(4·10⁵)/10 ≈ 63.
Asos: RLC analogiyasi.

en: In $Q=\frac{\omega_0}{2\beta}=\frac{\sqrt{km}}{b}$ substitute $m\to L$, $b\to R$, $k\to\frac{1}{C}$: $$Q=\frac{1}{R}\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}}=\frac{\sqrt{4\cdot10^5}}{10}\approx63$$

distractors.A: β = R/L deb olingan (Q ikki marta kichik)

question_en: The bobs of two identical pendulums of length $25\ \mathrm{cm}$ and mass $0.1\ \mathrm{kg}$ are joined by a light spring of stiffness $1\ \mathrm{N/m}$. What is the angular frequency of the higher normal mode?$\ g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_uz: Uzunligi $25\ \mathrm{cm}$, massasi $0.1\ \mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan ikkita bir xil mayatnik osilgan yuklari bikrligi $1\ \mathrm{N/m}$ bo'lgan yengil prujina bilan ulangan. Yuqori normal modaning siklik chastotasi qancha?$\ g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_ru: Грузы двух одинаковых маятников длиной $25\ \mathrm{cm}$ и массой $0.1\ \mathrm{kg}$ соединены лёгкой пружиной жёсткостью $1\ \mathrm{N/m}$. Какова циклическая частота высшей нормальной моды?$\ g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Qarama-qarshi fazadagi modada prujina ikki tomondan cho'ziladi: ω² = g/l + 2k′/m = 40 + 20.
Asos: normal modalar.

uz: Bir fazadagi moda $\omega_1^2=\frac{g}{l}=40$; qarama-qarshi fazadagi modada bog'lovchi prujina kuchi $2k'x$: $$\omega_2=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}+\frac{2k'}{m}}=\sqrt{40+20}=\sqrt{60}\approx7.75\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$$
ru: Синфазная мода $\omega_1^2=\frac{g}{l}=40$; в противофазной моде сила связывающей пружины $2k'x$: $$\omega_2=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}+\frac{2k'}{m}}=\sqrt{40+20}=\sqrt{60}\approx7.75\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$$
en: In-phase mode $\omega_1^2=\frac{g}{l}=40$; in the antiphase mode the coupling spring force is $2k'x$: $$\omega_2=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}+\frac{2k'}{m}}=\sqrt{40+20}=\sqrt{60}\approx7.75\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 1.7.1 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A point oscillates as $x=a\cos3t\cos47t$ ($t$ in seconds). It is the sum of which two harmonic oscillations (angular frequencies, $\mathrm{s^{-1}}$)?
question_uz: Nuqta $x=a\cos3t\cos47t$ qonun bilan tebranadi ($t$ — sekundlarda). Bu qanday ikki garmonik tebranish yig'indisi (siklik chastotalar, $\mathrm{s^{-1}}$)?
question_ru: Точка колеблется по закону $x=a\cos3t\cos47t$ ($t$ — в секундах). Суммой каких двух гармонических колебаний это является (циклические частоты, $\mathrm{s^{-1}}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. cos α cos β = ½[cos(α − β) + cos(α + β)]: 47 − 3 = 44 va 47 + 3 = 50.
Asos: tepish.

en: Convert the product into a sum: $$x=\frac{a}{2}\left(\cos44t+\cos50t\right)$$

distractors_en.A: the frequencies of the factors were given
distractors_en.B: only the upper frequency was found correctly

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 4.12-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A load ($m$) hangs from a string that passes over a disc-shaped pulley of mass $M$ and radius $R$; the other end is attached to a spring of stiffness $k$ fixed to the floor. The string does not slip on the pulley. What is the angular frequency of oscillation?
question_uz: Yuk ($m$) ip bilan bog'langan; ip massasi $M$, radiusi $R$ bo'lgan disk shaklidagi blok orqali o'tib, ikkinchi uchi polga mahkamlangan bikrligi $k$ prujinaga ulangan. Ip blokda sirpanmaydi. Tebranishlar siklik chastotasi qancha?
question_ru: Груз ($m$) привязан к нити, которая перекинута через блок в форме диска массой $M$ и радиусом $R$; другой конец нити прикреплён к пружине жёсткостью $k$, закреплённой на полу. Нить по блоку не скользит. Какова циклическая частота колебаний?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Energiya: mv²/2 + (MR²/2)(v/R)²/2 = (m + M/2)v²/2 — effektiv massa m + M/2.
Asos: energiya usuli.

uz: Blokning aylanma energiyasi effektiv massaga $\frac{M}{2}$ qo'shadi; og'irlik faqat muvozanatni siljitadi: $$\mu=m+\frac{M}{2},\qquad \omega_0=\sqrt{\frac{k}{m+\frac{M}{2}}}$$
ru: Энергия вращения блока добавляет к эффективной массе $\frac{M}{2}$; тяжесть лишь смещает равновесие: $$\mu=m+\frac{M}{2},\qquad \omega_0=\sqrt{\frac{k}{m+\frac{M}{2}}}$$
en: The pulley's rotational energy adds $\frac{M}{2}$ to the effective mass; gravity only shifts the equilibrium: $$\mu=m+\frac{M}{2},\qquad \omega_0=\sqrt{\frac{k}{m+\frac{M}{2}}}$$

distractors_en.B: the pulley was treated as a hoop (I = MR²)

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 4.54-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The water column in a U-tube has total length $60\ \mathrm{cm}$. The water levels are displaced from equilibrium and released. Neglecting friction, find the period of oscillation.$\ g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_uz: U shaklidagi naychadagi suv ustunining umumiy uzunligi $60\ \mathrm{cm}$. Suv sathlari muvozanatdan chiqarilib qo'yib yuborildi. Ishqalanishni hisobga olmasdan tebranish davrini toping.$\ g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_ru: Общая длина столба воды в U-образной трубке $60\ \mathrm{cm}$. Уровни воды вывели из равновесия и отпустили. Найдите период колебаний без учёта трения.$\ g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Sathlar farqi 2x, qaytaruvchi kuch 2ρgSx, massa ρSl: ω² = 2g/l, T = 2π√(0.03) ≈ 1.09 s.
Asos: suyuqlik ustuni tebranishi.

uz: Qaytaruvchi kuch $2\rho gSx$, harakatlanuvchi massa $\rho Sl$: $$\omega_0^2=\frac{2g}{l},\qquad T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{0.6}{20}}\approx1.09\ \mathrm{s}$$
ru: Возвращающая сила $2\rho gSx$, движущаяся масса $\rho Sl$: $$\omega_0^2=\frac{2g}{l},\qquad T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{0.6}{20}}\approx1.09\ \mathrm{s}$$
en: Restoring force $2\rho gSx$, moving mass $\rho Sl$: $$\omega_0^2=\frac{2g}{l},\qquad T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{0.6}{20}}\approx1.09\ \mathrm{s}$$

distractors.A: sathlar farqi x deb olingan (ω² = g/l)

distractors_ru.A: разность уровней принята равной x (ω² = g/l)

distractors_en.A: the level difference was taken as x (ω² = g/l)

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 4.27-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: An undamped oscillator ($m=0.5\ \mathrm{kg}$, $\omega_0=20\ \mathrm{rad/s}$) is acted on from $t=0$ by a force $2\cos\omega_0t\ \mathrm{N}$; initially the body was at rest at equilibrium. What is the oscillation amplitude after $5\ \mathrm{s}$?
question_uz: So'nishsiz ossilyatorga ($m=0.5\ \mathrm{kg}$, $\omega_0=20\ \mathrm{rad/s}$) $t=0$ dan boshlab $2\cos\omega_0t\ \mathrm{N}$ kuch ta'sir qila boshladi; boshida jism muvozanatda tinch turgan. $5\ \mathrm{s}$ dan keyin tebranish amplitudasi qancha?
question_ru: На незатухающий осциллятор ($m=0.5\ \mathrm{kg}$, $\omega_0=20\ \mathrm{rad/s}$) с момента $t=0$ начала действовать сила $2\cos\omega_0t\ \mathrm{N}$; вначале тело покоилось в равновесии. Какова амплитуда колебаний через $5\ \mathrm{s}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. So'nishsiz rezonansda amplituda chiziqli o'sadi: F₀t/(2mω₀) = 2·5/(2·0.5·20) = 0.5 m.
Asos: so'nishsiz rezonans.

uz: Yechim $x=\frac{F_0t}{2m\omega_0}\sin\omega_0t$ (tenglamaga qo'yib tekshiriladi), amplituda vaqtga proporsional: $$A(t)=\frac{2\cdot5}{2\cdot0.5\cdot20}=0.5\ \mathrm{m}$$
en: The solution $x=\frac{F_0t}{2m\omega_0}\sin\omega_0t$ (checked by substitution); the amplitude is proportional to time: $$A(t)=\frac{2\cdot5}{2\cdot0.5\cdot20}=0.5\ \mathrm{m}$$

distractors_en.B: the 2 in the denominator was forgotten
distractors_en.C: the factor t was forgotten: F₀/(2mω₀)
distractors_en.D: ω₀² was used instead of ω₀: F₀t/(mω₀²)

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 4.83-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan
